spine.active_goal: After the settings, About and in-app updates build (run home ~/.mitosis/field-notes/settings-about-updates) ships, merges and is released with a tag, publish a closed testing (Alpha) release in Play Console and send the app for Google's first review, so the temporary name 'dev.satanshumishra.field_notes (unreviewed)' becomes "Field Notes" and the app stops being a Draft app. The owner asked for this on 2026-10-11 as the follow-on step to that release.
spine.next_step: Draft closed-testing release 1.0.0 (bundle version code 10, 178 countries, testers list Field Notes testers) now has en-US release notes, saved as draft 2026-10-12; nothing sent for review (owner: do not publish). One error blocks Preview and confirm: the Foreground service permissions declaration (App content) for FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC, used by UploadWorker.kt for journal uploads with the "Uploading to your journal" notification. Answer: Network processing, Other (uploading or downloading); Play also requires a video link showing that use. The owner supplies the video (or asks for a lab emulator recording they host), saves the declaration, then Next and Save on the release, then Send for review in Publishing overview when they choose. After approval, confirm c1 and delete PLAY_RELEASE_STATUS for c2. Production access later needs 12 opted-in testers for 14 days (0 opted in on 2026-10-12).
